test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the one which completes the series: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42320a79bcc391a7104e69986ac128db2e38f85cf431d61a97b47aae3f062dc6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The four curved lines (arcs) rotate **90° clockwise** in each consecutive figure.

So far, the first figure shows the arcs in a vertical arrangement. In the second figure, all arcs rotate **90° clockwise**, becoming horizontal. In the third figure, they again rotate **90° clockwise**, returning to a vertical position but with reversed orientation.

Following this consistent pattern, the next figure must show another **90° clockwise rotation**, making the arcs horizontal again but now facing the opposite direction (downward).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea207c5038b6d1c85eb1a26e9cd3076ad78a7bc8c3eb5aede116d492677dbbc.png] 

Thus, the required figure must have **horizontal arcs facing downward**, completing the rotation sequence.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
